summary.title: Fixing main.py to print Hello, world!
summary.body: I fixed two bugs that kept `python3 main.py` from running: in `main.py` I changed the import from the nonexistent `greetings` module to `greeter`, and in `greeter.py` I added the missing colon after `def greet(name)`. I then ran the program to confirm it exits cleanly and prints `
